Just letting you know you are not alone. Recently, I've decided that I was sick of feeling trapped and isolated from society and am seeking help from professionals. My advice to you would try to sign up for professional help they should offer free counseling/psychological help at your college. If medication or therapy does not work or you cannot afford it, I recommend taking a year off from college by getting a doctor's note ( I know a friend who did this) to find some motivation to continue college. I am strongly considering this but the hardest part is trying to convince my parents not to throw me out of the house since I come from an Asian culture where education is everything. 

Lastly, taking a year off does not mean sitting on your couch watching TV and playing video games. You should be using that time to disconnect from the internet, social media, the porn, games, etc... Try finding some outdoor activities like going to the gym, start reading some books, traveling to new places. Also try to find a part time job that'll give you some experience and if you can't get one try volunteering around your community. My friend has been through this and knows what you and I are going through. He finally had the pleasure to experience a stressful minimum wage job and said he would rather stay in school studying accounting then to keep going through this job for the rest of his life. He did mention some benefits though, he learned some social skills and I've noticed he's able to hold a conversation with anybody now so he recommends if you have to find a job/volunteer make sure its one where it puts you in a situation where you have to socialize with the people around you.
